ContainerCapacity.definition: Number of units of oil each container can hold

TruckCapacity.definition: Number of units of oil each truck can hold

TruckToContainerRatio.definition: Maximum allowed ratio of number of trucks to number of containers

MinimumOilSent.definition: Minimum number of units of oil that need to be sent to the port

MinimumContainers.definition: Minimum number of containers that need to be used
